item.title: [news] Single-shot and agentic retrieval with Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base

item.title: [news] Claude Fable 5.2 Scores 65 on Artificial Analysis, Highest So Far
item.description: Claude Fable 5.2 scored 65 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, making it one of the highest-scoring models tested so far.

item.title: [news] Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 on AWS
item.description: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 are now available on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS. Learn what's new in both models, why Fable 5.2 matters for your technical workloads, and how to get started building with it on Amazon Bedrock.

item.title: [news] NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
item.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120-billion-parameter multimodal vision-language model, is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart for machine learning workloads.

item.title: [news] The backlash about data centers might really just be about electricity
item.description: This story originally appeared in The Algorithm, our weekly newsletter on AI. To get stories like this in your inbox first, sign up here.

item.title: [news] Pluggable Agentic AI Framework: A seven-layer composable enterprise agentic AI reference architecture on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: Seven-layer composable reference architecture on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore helps enterprises transition agentic AI systems from prototype to production with swappable technologies.

item.title: [news] ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
item.description: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

item.title: [news] Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2

item.title: [news] How CrossnoKaye grounds physical AI with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: CrossnoKaye brought physical AI to heavy industry with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

item.title: [news] Professional work deserves professional tools. Meet AWS Quick.
item.description: Introducing AWS Quick, formerly Amazon Quick, and the debut of our first brand campaign celebrating teams who keep business moving.

item.title: [news] DeepX claims inference up to 100B parameters at less than 5 W
item.description: DeepX taped out its DX-M2 edge AI chip using Samsung PIM technology to run large language models of up to 100 billion parameters at under 5 watts.

item.title: [news] Google Gemini routes personal Drive files and emails to human annotators
item.description: Documentation showing how Google Gemini routes personal Google Drive files and emails into human review pipelines when connected apps are enabled.

item.title: [tool] STE80 Humanizer – de-AI text by writing 80% of the way to ASD-STE100
item.description: STE80 Humanizer is an agent skill that rewrites AI-generated text to resemble Simplified Technical English for improved readability without altering its core meaning.

item.description: California state senator Scott Wiener won a congressional seat, positioning him to play a key role in setting federal artificial intelligence policy.

item.title: [news] Innovating with AI in the special chemicals industry
item.description: As companies look to accelerate innovation with artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and advanced modeling, the primary challenge is connecting new technologies to reliable data, scientific expertise, and the practical realities of bringing products to market.

item.title: [news] ChatGPT Desktop forwards your SSH agent to remote machines
item.description: ChatGPT Desktop feature that forwards a user's local SSH agent to remote machines so remote agents can authenticate using local credentials.

item.title: [news] CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
item.description: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern AI-generated code and ship software 20 times faster with the same engineering team.

item.title: [news] Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
item.description: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of drawings, helping engineers find repair documents in minutes instead of hours.

item.title: [news] Apple capped engineers at a $200 daily AI budget
item.description: Report indicating that Apple reduced the daily AI spending limit for some of its internal engineers from $300 to $200.

item.description: High-performance inference engine for Jev-like decision models that achieves up to a 9.5x speedup over vLLM and SGLang using exact state forking.

item.title: [repo] assassin808/learn-from-lessons
item.description: Learn from Lessons is a tool that reads local coding agent transcripts to extract user corrections and turn them into structured lessons for future sessions.

item.title: [tool] Recalc – Spreadsheet where cells can be Claude Code or Codex terminals
item.description: Recalc is a spreadsheet-based harness that allows users to share a grid with AI agents like Claude Code and Codex, where every cell can act as a terminal.

item.description: Tool that turns a photo into a 10-second video for free without requiring a GPU queue.

item.title: [paper] Authorization Drift in LLM Agents: Evaluating Boundary Compliance in Multi-Step Tool Use
item.description: Large language model agents can exceed authorized limits while pursuing user goals, and a 648-sample benchmark across seven domains shows that this drift rises with capability yet is avoidable and carries cross-jurisdictional privacy and information-security risks.

item.title: [model] ConwayResearch/Underdog-Woof
item.description: Text-to-speech model from ConwayResearch. 10 downloads and 124 likes so far.

item.title: [repo] XploraHub/awesome-mineral-exploration
item.description: Awesome Mineral Exploration is a curated list of open-source software and tools for mineral exploration, geophysics, geological modelling, and related geoscience tasks.

item.title: [repo] Zenithopal/LooseEnds-resp
item.description: Tying up what The Sims 4 leaves dangling

item.title: [model] Comfy-Org/RelayVSR
item.description: Unconditional image generation model from Comfy-Org. 52.8k downloads and 123 likes so far.

item.title: [paper] Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
item.description: New benchmarks and molecular dynamics frameworks are presented to rigorously evaluate protein scaffold-generation models by assessing dynamic fidelity and structural stability beyond static success.

item.title: [repo] chenhg5/myco
item.description: Myco is a single-binary application that connects Claude Code, Codex, and other agent CLIs across different machines into a single network for task delegation and management.

item.title: [paper] IWIBench: Evaluating Gradient-Free Model Driven Intra-weight Injection
item.description: Intra-weight injection lets one model change another model's behaviour by editing its weights directly, without gradients. Such edits can range from altering lexical associations to enforcing output formats or updating factual knowledge.

item.title: [repo] cacheMon/PrefixSim
item.description: PrefixSim is a fast simulator for LLM serving engine KV-block prefix caches that evaluates eviction policies based on compute saving ratios rather than just block hit ratios.

item.title: [repo] munitkala/selfsemester
item.description: SelfSemester is a Windows desktop app that uses Claude Code to build, schedule, and grade complete university-style courses based on user-defined subjects and learning goals.

item.title: [paper] LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
item.description: A method compresses KV caches by predicting values from keys within each attention head and applying cross-layer low-rank key compression, enabling higher decoding throughput and composability with quantization and eviction.

item.title: [model] VideoRebirthAI/hyperflow-h3-flash
item.description: Image text to video model from VideoRebirthAI. 64.2k downloads and 131 likes so far.

item.title: [repo] sshah03/recalc
item.description: Recalc is an open-source spreadsheet application for macOS and Linux where individual cells can function as values, formulas, terminal commands, or AI coding agents.

item.title: [repo] guard-spec/guard-spec
item.description: Self-hosted prompt-injection firewall and OpenAI-compatible gateway that blocks prompt injection and checks model outputs for exfiltration links, personal data, and leaked canaries in English and Vietnamese.

item.title: [paper] P^2-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
item.description: P^2-MOPD jointly optimizes mixing coefficients and student weights under an on-policy distillation objective, enabling faster and more balanced recovery than MOPD by treating experts as parameter priors while keeping the student trainable.

item.title: [paper] Human-Centred, Risk-Constrained Evaluation of Financial Document Recognition: Evidence, Critical Errors, and Selective Automation
item.description: Financial document recognition is often assessed using character and word error rates, although these metrics do not express whether a system preserves the financial facts on which people and organisations act.

item.title: [paper] Fast and Exact Relative-Position Attention via Structure-Aware Kernels
item.description: An exact tiled attention algorithm integrates additive relative-position terms into FlashAttention-style computation, reducing memory and compute overhead and accelerating long-context relative-position transformers.

item.title: [paper] Learning to evolve by matching velocities
item.description: Velocity Matching is a simulation-free objective for learning continuous-time dynamics that avoids long-rollout instability and numerical-scheme bias while providing theoretical guarantees and improved accuracy on ODEs and PDEs.

item.title: [paper] Hard Sample-Conditioned Decorrelated Attention for Robust Face Recognition
item.description: ViT-HarDis conditions attention head disentanglement on sample difficulty in face recognition, applying stronger decorrelation to hard samples to improve identity discrimination without architectural changes or extra inference cost.

item.title: [paper] Hierarchical Residuals: A Minimalist Decoupling of Residual Width from Compute Width
item.description: Hierarchical Residuals decouple residual width from per-layer compute width by connecting standard Transformer blocks through a wider outer residual path, improving efficiency and accuracy without specialized kernels.

item.description: Open-source community project that routes coding agent requests to project managers who run parallel workers in git worktrees.

item.description: Trending on Hacker News from sergeykuhne.com. 210 points and 161 comments.

item.title: [repo] kanaworksai-hue/sozai-search-mcp
item.description: Model context protocol server that provides AI agents with semantic search access to a library of 36,000 free 3D assets.

item.title: [repo] tailucanh/offload-mcp-server
item.description: Model context protocol server that allows a main coding agent to delegate heavy file-reading tasks to a background agent.

item.title: [news] Terry Pratchett's Study
item.description: My comment on Terry Pratchett's Study — Hacker News. Terry Pratchett once wrote about the concept of "horizontal wealth". Vertical wealth is where you spend money on rich people stuff - yachts and suchlike.

item.title: [repo] avivgerz-hue/vibe-shield
item.description: Static security scanner and agent skill for auditing AI-generated codebases against 60 security and configuration rules.

item.title: [repo] kilolonion/agent-vscreen
item.description: Android app that provides a background virtual screen to run phone AI agents invisibly while you continue using your device normally.

item.title: [paper] Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
item.description: Video-Coder is a code-driven video generation agent that writes and executes code to build structured 3D draft videos, then uses supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with execution and video rewards to improve controllable video generation.

item.title: [paper] On Agentic Manipulation Policies
item.description: Researchers propose agentic manipulation policies, a reference harness allowing generalist AI models to command robot manipulators directly without task-specific training, achieving state-of-the-art results on manipulation benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
item.description: Agentic reasoning caching is a method that constructs CPU-executable reasoning caches from LLM reasoning traces, enabling efficient solution reuse for mathematical and scientific tasks at a fraction of the source model's cost.

item.title: [paper] On the (non-)closedness of the set of ReLU networks
item.description: A mathematical proof demonstrates that the set of one-hidden-layer ReLU networks with a bounded number of neurons is weakly closed in a specific Sobolev space, while the two-hidden-layer case is not.

item.title: [paper] FlowMoP: Stochastic Multi-Person Motion Prediction
item.description: FlowMoP is a conditional flow matching framework that jointly generates diverse future motions for multiple agents using a B-spline reparameterization and a dual-stream transformer for interaction-aware forecasting.

item.title: [paper] ZeoBench: A Benchmark for Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Zeolite Representations
item.description: ZeoBench is a benchmark for self-supervised learning on 3D zeolite representations, used to evaluate features on downstream adsorption-property prediction tasks and improve materials discovery in low-data regimes.

item.title: [paper] Graded convolutional networks: scale invariance without the scale and robustness to unknown blur
item.description: Graded convolutional networks utilize local graded convolutions and retractions to achieve scale invariance and robustness to unknown Gaussian blur without explicit scale parameters.

item.title: [paper] On the Reliability of Majority-Vote Pseudo-Labels in Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Prompt-Conditional Distributionally Robust DPO is a test-time reinforcement learning method that conditions robust reweighting on vote reliability to reduce errors from sampling-sensitive prompts.

item.title: [paper] CodeQuant2: Enhanced Outlier Mitigation and Adaptive Clustering for Low-Precision LRMs
item.description: CodeQuant2 is a clustering-based lookup table quantization framework for low-precision large reasoning models that uses rotation, scaling, and improved calibration to enhance reasoning accuracy and inference speed.

item.title: [paper] GRAC: Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Captioning for Surgical Scene Description
item.description: Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Captioning is a framework that represents surgical scenes as graphs to retrieve relevant examples and improve the language quality and factual accuracy of automated surgical captions.

item.title: [paper] Grasp-TAGS: Task-Aware Grasp Selection via Critic Distillation for Prehensile Loco-Manipulation
item.description: Grasp-TAGS is a task-aware grasp selection framework for goal-conditioned large-object rearrangement that distills a reinforcement learning critic into a lightweight network to rank candidate grasps by downstream utility.

item.title: [paper] Flow-Guided Target-Space Alignment via Path Consistency
item.description: FlowAlign is a flow-guided target-space alignment method that uses conditional flow matching to guide source representations into a fixed target space while preserving paired correspondence and global structure.

item.title: [paper] Super-resolved digital terrain models for GEDI geolocation correction: agreement with airborne LiDAR DTM-based corrections at the beam level, not the footprint level
item.description: Study on super-resolved digital terrain models finds that super-resolving a 10-meter DTM to 1-meter yields beam-level GEDI geolocation corrections that match airborne LiDAR DTM corrections, though footprint-level corrections do not match.

item.title: [paper] Health-System-Wide Mapping of Demographic Information in Routine Clinical Histopathology
item.description: Study using 1.3 million clinical histopathology images demonstrates that patient demographic attributes such as sex, age group, and race are broadly recoverable across multiple organs using pathology foundation models.

item.title: [paper] How far does a hash-only sender go? A pre-registered map of sender memory versus bits for short text messages
item.description: Study mapping sender memory versus bits for short text messages finds that a hash-only sender can transmit text cheaply compared to classical senders, though failures incur additional airtime and acknowledgement costs.

item.title: [paper] Computer-Use Agents Are Embodied Generalists
item.description: Study argues that computer-use agents can serve as embodied generalists by performing embodied tasks through screen rendering and software controls without task-specific agent tuning.

item.title: [paper] Ensemble Methodology for Reference-Free Confidence Estimation in LLM-based Code Summarization
item.description: Reference-free confidence estimation approach for LLM-based COBOL summarization uses diverse model generation, an LLM evaluator for pairwise assessments, and a calibrated aggregation rule to estimate summary correctness without human references.

item.title: [paper] AdaptivePnP: Fast Auto-Tuned Plug-and-Play for Deconvolution
item.description: AdaptivePnP proposes an auto-tuned plug-and-play framework for image deconvolution that jointly estimates measurement noise and step size from data-fitting residuals without requiring parameter tuning.

item.title: [paper] Fifty-Two Shades of Pig: What the UCR Archive Really Asks Classifiers to Do
item.description: An audit of the UCR Time Series Classification Archive reveals that many benchmark datasets are repurposed from original tasks, use flawed test splits, or rely on toy setups, urging more careful interpretation of archive scores.

item.title: [paper] Can Agentic Systems Close the Gap in Radiology with Production AI Tools?
item.description: A radiology agentic framework combines specialized and generalist AI tools through an orchestrator to automate structured report generation and evaluate finding recovery from FDA-cleared devices.

item.title: [paper] Designing Effective Monitor-Based Interventions for Mitigating Reward Hacking During RL
item.description: Three realistic reinforcement learning environments are introduced to study and mitigate reward hacking, demonstrating that monitors leaking more learning signal can suppress hacking but increase evasive behavior.

item.title: [paper] BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design
item.description: BitDecoding-FP4 introduces an algorithm-system co-design for native FP4 KV cache decoding that eliminates quantization errors and softmax bottlenecks to deliver higher peak serving throughput in large language models.

item.title: [paper] Discovering formally verified quantum programs with AI
item.description: Large language model agents collaborating within a formal proof assistant discover and verify quantum programs, achieving order-of-magnitude improvements across several scientific applications.

item.title: [paper] Generative Latent Priors for Interpreting and Steering Protein Language Models
item.description: Generative Latent Priors apply diffusion models directly to protein language model activations without structural assumptions to serve as a lens for protein representations and an editing prior for steering properties.

item.title: [paper] Machine learning for lattice QCD
item.description: This book chapter provides an introduction and summary of machine learning methods used to optimize lattice field theory calculations without introducing uncontrolled approximations.

item.title: [paper] BEV3SR: Evidence-Aware 3D Spatial Reasoning from Video
item.description: BEV3SR is a training-free framework that converts RGB-D videos into metric bird's-eye-view scene memory to improve 3D spatial reasoning and query-based question answering across vision-language models.

item.title: [paper] The Cost of Coverage: Conformalising Native Forecast Uncertainty for GB Wind Power
item.description: Applying conformal prediction to native wind forecast uncertainty bands repairs marginal coverage and cuts out-of-band volume in high winds by over forty percent when calibrated by forecast wind regime.

item.title: [paper] Compaction, decay and reinforcement in a two-tier conversational memory: a paired evaluation against retrieval-augmented generation
item.description: Conversational memory method that compacts turns into atomic facts outperforms retrieval-augmented generation on value-based questions while using fewer tokens.

item.title: [paper] Scaling Graph Similarity Learning with Graph Neural Networks
item.description: FiLSim is a scalable graph neural network framework that computes graph similarity for large graphs with over 150,000 nodes within seconds.

item.title: [paper] When Instruction Files Go Stale: Documentation Debt and Hidden Cost in Coding Agents
item.description: Coding agents frequently follow stale repository instruction files when relevant to their tasks, increasing tool call usage and introducing documentation debt.

item.title: [paper] Maya a1: Do the Options Read the Model, or Does Their Position? Order Sensitivity in a Non-Autoregressive Decision Model
item.description: Option order sensitivity study on a non-autoregressive model reveals that answer choices fluctuate based on their listed position, which is mitigated by fine-tuning with shuffling.

item.title: [paper] Test-Time Compute Scales Better with Parallel Agent Teams
item.description: Parallel agent teams sample many small collaborating groups in the same setup to scale test-time compute, outperforming single agents and large teams.

item.title: [paper] AR-Edit: Training-Free Autoregressive Video Editing without Inversion
item.description: AR-Edit is a training-free and inversion-free video editing method that caches and reuses source values for real-time streaming video generation.

item.title: [paper] Seeing What Matters: Benchmarking Task-Conditioned Actionable Spatial Belief for Manipulation
item.description: Seeing What Matters is a new simulated benchmark designed to evaluate whether vision-language models and policies select the correct camera views for manipulation tasks.

item.title: [paper] Knowing When to Intervene: Causal Evaluation of AI Agents
item.description: A new causal inference framework estimates the dynamic effects of randomized interventions within AI agent trajectories to prioritize audits and improve safety.

item.title: [paper] Assessing the Impact of Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Algorithmic Problem-Solving
item.description: Retrieval-augmented generation approach integrating embedding-based retrieval and similarity search helps large language models solve competitive programming problems.

item.title: [paper] Are These Programmers Ripe Enough to Eat? Evaluating How LLMs Handle Lexical Knowledge Conflicts in Translation
item.description: Controlled study on Mandarin-to-English translation investigates how large language models handle conflicts between external lexical resources and their prior knowledge.

item.title: [paper] Quasipolynomial-Time Planning for Decodable POMDPs
item.description: Approximation algorithms based on decodability provide quasipolynomial-time planning for finite-horizon POMDPs under weaker assumptions than prior methods.

item.title: [paper] ROSE: Risk-Aware Orthogonal Subspace Navigation for Lifelong Knowledge Editing in Multimodal Large Language Models
item.description: Risk-Aware Orthogonal Subspace Navigation is a framework for multimodal large language models that prevents catastrophic forgetting and locality erosion during lifelong knowledge editing.

item.title: [paper] AnimWeb-Bench: Benchmarking Animated Webpage Code Generation from Videos
item.description: AnimWeb-Bench is a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models and coding agents on generating animated webpage code from reference videos.

item.title: [paper] Language as Trait, Politeness as Strategy: Controlled Tests of Linguistic Effects in LLM Social-Deduction Agents
item.description: Controlled tests using the LURK Werewolf framework show that varying linguistic range and politeness in LLM social-dedction agents does not significantly affect trust or voting behavior.

item.title: [paper] From PAC bounds on the generalization error to PAC bounds on the parameter estimation error
item.description: Oracle bounds derived from classical PAC bounds are used to establish finite-sample parameter-estimation error bounds for regularized loss minimization in dynamical systems.

item.title: [paper] A Tight Hierarchy for Chain of Thought
item.description: A new hierarchy theorem proves that increasing chain-of-thought reasoning steps provably increases the computational power of transformer-based models.

item.title: [paper] Diffusion-free Score Matching for Exact Conditional Sampling
item.description: Diffusion-free score matching estimates a single score of a perturbed data distribution to enable exact conditional sampling without time-dependent diffusion fields.

item.title: [paper] A lightweight convolutional neural network for target detection in an edge environment
item.description: A lightweight convolutional neural network is designed for edge deployment to perform real-time threat detection and object classification using thermal sensors.

item.title: [paper] Continuous wavelet-based feature extraction for laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy classification of human plasma samples
item.description: Continuous wavelet transform-based spectral peak extraction coupled with a support vector machine classifies human plasma samples using laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy data.

item.title: [paper] Multiscale Closing Index (MCI) for measuring structural similarity between 2D point sets
item.description: Multi-scale Closing Index is a multiscale morphological dissimilarity measure for evaluating structural alignment and registration quality between two-dimensional point sets.

item.title: [paper] Zero-Shot Benchmarking of Unified Multimodal Models for Shallow-Water UAV Image Distortion Assessment and Restoration
item.description: Zero-shot benchmark that evaluates five unified multimodal large language models on their ability to assess and restore shallow-water UAV imagery without reference images.

item.title: [paper] Safety Is $Π_1$, Provability Is $Σ_1$: One Framework for the Hugging Face Breach and OpenAI's Mathematical Proofs
item.description: Hybrid framework that models program safety and mathematical provability through a single deductive mechanism based on Turing's Undecidability Theorem.

item.title: [paper] What to Delegate, What to Preserve: Human Preferences for Agentic AI Across Everyday Life and Work
item.description: Scenario-based survey that identifies user preferences for human-AI collaboration, showing that trust and desired leadership drive automation choices across everyday and work tasks.

item.title: [paper] One Run Is Not Enough: A Monte Carlo Protocol for Evaluating LLM Reliability on Data Science Tasks
item.description: Monte Carlo protocol and benchmark dataset designed to evaluate the consistency and reliability of large language models on data science and statistics tasks.

item.title: [paper] SAGE-PAIR: Source-Pretrained Routed Residual Adaptation for Sparse-Feedback Recommendation
item.description: Staged adapter framework that uses source-pretrained residual corrections to improve recommendation ranking quality under extremely sparse feedback conditions.

item.title: [paper] TriNetra: Thermal-Reliability-Guided RGB-Thermal Fusion and Tracking for Surveillance
item.description: Reliability-aware surveillance framework that uses a thermal reliability coefficient to gate and fuse RGB-thermal video streams for robust object detection and tracking.

item.title: [paper] Evaluating Anterior Cruciate Ligament Risk of Injury Using a Graph Convolutional Autoencoder
item.description: Smartphone-based unsupervised learning model that uses graph convolutional networks and pose estimation data to screen athletes for anterior cruciate ligament injury risk.

item.title: [paper] Fixed-point acceleration on Neural Wasserstein manifolds
item.description: Fixed-point acceleration method that applies Riemannian Anderson mixing to optimize probability measures over neural Wasserstein manifolds more efficiently.

item.title: [paper] FOSCAR: Accelerating Decode Attention over 2- and 4-Bit KV Caches through Affine Folding
item.description: Affine folding method that accelerates large-language-model decode attention over 2-bit and 4-bit quantized key-value caches by drastically reducing scale-and-offset operations.

item.title: [paper] MemoryDojo: Benchmarking Poisoning Through LLM Agent Memory
item.description: Benchmark suite for evaluating how malicious instructions propagate through and poison different large language model agent memory systems across multi-session tasks.

item.title: [paper] Direct Regression and Geometric Recovery for Event-based Spacecraft Pose Estimation
item.description: Comparative study of two synthetic-to-real event-based spacecraft pose estimation systems finds that direct regression reduces orientation error while a modular pipeline reduces relative translation error.

item.title: [paper] Intent-Aware Caching for Efficient LLM Serving
item.description: Intent-Aware Caching classifies conversation requests by user intent and learns lightweight reuse statistics to improve cache hit rates and reduce LLM serving latency.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Segmentation: Enriching ImageCAS with Coronary Ostia Landmarks, Rooted Centerline Graphs, and Open-Weight Localization Models
item.description: Enriched ImageCAS dataset adds coronary ostium annotations and rooted centerlines to 1,000 patient scans, enabling improved 3D ostium localization and vessel analysis.

item.title: [paper] ICare-DT: a digital twin for continuous forecasting of intensive care patients
item.description: ICare-DT is a Transformer-based digital twin that continuously updates intensive care patient states hourly from new measurements to forecast vital signs and treatment responses.

item.title: [paper] RidgeFill: Training-Free Late-Layer Cache Fill for Faster Prefill
item.description: RidgeFill uses closed-form ridge regression maps to predict upper-layer inputs from lower-layer states, accelerating LLM prefill time without requiring model retraining.

item.title: [paper] Empirical Assessment of Post-Quantum Cryptography Adoption Status in TLS
item.description: Empirical assessment of post-quantum cryptography adoption across seven critical protocols reveals that origin-server support reaches 9.1% for HTTPS but remains below 1% for other protocols.

item.title: [paper] Empirical Study of Post-Quantum Cryptography Adoption Status in SSH Infrastructure
item.description: Large-scale analysis of SSH infrastructure shows that post-quantum cryptography adoption is highly polarized, with 45.2% of hosts supporting PQC while 54.8% remain classical-only.

item.title: [paper] Where Should Learning Live? Regret Analysis for Text, Parameter, and Joint Adaptation
item.description: Analysis of language-model adaptation compares prompt and parameter selection, showing that limiting configuration switches can reduce within-family regret depending on inherited histories.

item.title: [paper] Attend at the Right Resolution: Head-Adaptive Sparse Attention via Query-Key Interaction Structure
item.description: Head-Adaptive Sparse Attention is a training-free framework that adapts selection resolution along feature and sequence dimensions using query-key interaction structures to reduce attention bottlenecks.

item.title: [paper] Verifier Noise Is a Temperature: Testing Tilt Predictions in Finite-Budget LLM-Guided Search
item.description: Empirical tests on LLM-guided program search evaluate stationary law tilt predictions, finding that search performance varies with minibatch size and parent-child quality correlations.

item.title: [paper] A Generalized Bayesian Approach to Clustering with Dimension Reduction
item.description: Generalized Bayes product partition models are extended by jointly learning an autoencoder and a partition, allowing the clustering loss to adaptively shape the latent space for high-dimensional data.

item.title: [paper] PoseRieFlow: Riemannian Flow Matching for Whole-Body Text-to-Pose Generation
item.description: PoseRieFlow is a compact Riemannian flow-matching framework for text-to-pose generation that models joint rotations on a product manifold to achieve high kinematic fidelity for whole-body 3D human poses with articulated hands.

item.title: [paper] SURE:Spatiotemporal Uncertainty Representation for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Learning
item.description: SURE is a data-efficient vision-language-action training framework that models spatial and temporal uncertainty using a probabilistic action decoder and Soft-DTW alignment to improve robotic manipulation performance.

item.title: [paper] The Multiscale Single-Index Model: An MSE Analysis of Online SGD Dynamics
item.description: This work analyzes joint online spherical SGD under MSE loss for the Multiscale Single-Index Model, proving that it achieves weak and strong recovery in hierarchical feature learning settings.

item.title: [paper] SPARSEUP: Towards Better Recipes for Training Modern Learned Sparse Retrievers
item.description: SPARSEUP is a training recipe for Splade-like sparse encoders that uses logit distribution control, per-position fan-out capping, and vocabulary merging to improve efficiency and retrieval effectiveness.

item.title: [paper] Autonomous Particle Image Velocimetry Using Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Autonomous Particle Image Velocimetry uses a zero-shot sim-to-real reinforcement learning agent to control a camera-equipped manipulator for locating and resolving hydrofoil wakes in water tunnels.

item.title: [paper] Goodhart in the Planner: Sampling-Based Control Exploits Rewards Learned from Human Preferences
item.description: Sampling-based control algorithms using human-preference reward models can degrade true objective performance through reward hacking, which is mitigated by a proposed calibrated regularization rule.

item.title: [paper] Online Causal Configuration for Networked Systems via Doubly Robust Steady-State Learning
item.description: CAUSAL-UCB is an online causal configuration algorithm that uses an interference-aware clipped doubly robust evaluator to balance measurement exploration and target optimization in networked systems.

item.title: [paper] Dual Architecture Fusion Vehicle Lidar 3D Target Detection
item.description: SpconvTransformer is a 3D target detection network that combines a sparse convolutional branch for local features with a Transformer branch for global context to improve vehicle lidar detection accuracy.

item.title: [paper] How Much Conversation History Does an AI Agent Need?
item.description: An empirical analysis of conversation history length on AI agent performance shows how varying passage budgets and message retention impact token usage, benchmark scores, and task accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Video2Asset: Online Construction of Persistent 3D Street-Scene Assets
item.description: Video2Asset is an online framework that converts multi-view videos into continually updated 3D street-scene assets with improved temporal identity consistency and reduced fragmentation.

item.title: [paper] Differentially Private GraphRAG: Protecting Relation Connectivity and Semantics
item.description: RelGuard is a differentially private GraphRAG framework that protects relation connectivity and semantic meaning through relation removal to defend against reconstruction attacks.

item.title: [paper] Decoupled Mode Connectivity for Base-to-Novel Generalization in Vision-Language Models
item.description: Decoupled Mode Connectivity is a prompt learning method that uses separate specialization and generalization prompts to improve base-to-novel generalization in vision-language models.

item.title: [paper] Breaking the Privacy Promise: Gradient Inversion Attacks on Federated Low-Rank Adapted Vision Transformers
item.description: Spatially anchored generative inversion is a framework that uses server-prescribed trainable positional embeddings to improve gradient inversion reconstructions for LoRA-adapted Vision Transformers.

item.title: [paper] TensorMutation: Learning Weight-Space Mutations of Deep Learning Models on Neural Graphs
item.description: TensorMutation is a method that represents trained models as neural graphs and uses a graph neural network to predict parameter changes for generating executable deep learning mutants without retraining.

item.title: [paper] NAVE: A Normalized, Adaptive Conformer for Antarctic Whale Vocalization Detection
item.description: NAVE is a Conformer-based detector that combines per-bin complex mean subtraction, per-channel energy normalization, and a frequency-dynamic stem to accurately detect Antarctic whale vocalizations in noisy recordings.

item.title: [paper] Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
item.description: LambdaMix is a parameter-efficient method that jointly trains low-rank adapters to create a preference-conditioned family of policies for multi-objective language model adaptation.
